scientific_integrity: The proof uses known radial beta eigenvalues and mode selection, then establishes all three joint-scaling norm limits with gamma density convergence. Independent audit not performed. Finite tests do not prove infinite limits.
scientific_limitations: Fixed rho>0, radial near-boundary hyperbolic annuli with arbitrary positive H(U); three regimes for H(U)/U, no uniform error rates or nonradial masks. The exact finite-index beta staircase and fixed-H thin law were known; novelty claimed only for the complete joint-scaling phase diagram, especially critical and wide widths.
title: Three-regime hyperbolic-annulus concentration law for analytic wavelets
